title: Certification Record for the Ridgecrest RxSecure Plan Benefit Packages
content:
Each Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is approved by CMS for the states and the membership recorded here, and carries the overall star rating CMS most recently published for it. Medication therapy management is offered on the terms each plan gives.

| Plan | Most recent CMS overall star rating | States in which the plan may be sold and held | Membership CMS has approved for the plan benefit package | Maintenance drugs at which medication therapy management is offered | Annual drug cost at which it is offered (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 3.0 | Northfield, Calder | 42000 | 8 | 5330.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 3.5 | Northfield, Calder | 38000 | 8 | 5330.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 4.0 | Northfield, Calder, Wexham | 26500 | 8 | 5330.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 4.0 | Northfield, Calder, Wexham | 19800 | 7 | 5330.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 4.5 | Northfield, Calder, Wexham, Brennan | 11400 | 7 | 5330.0 |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 4.5 | Northfield, Calder, Wexham, Brennan | 6300 | 6 | 5330.0 |

## Reading the record

The service area widens as the plans rise: Northfield and Calder on the two lowest, Wexham added on Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) and Plus (PDP), and Brennan added again on Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP). The approved membership falls the other way, from 42000 on Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) to 6300 on Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP). Star ratings run from 3.0 to 4.5, with Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) and Plus (PDP) sharing 4.0 and Complete (PDP) and Premier (PDP) sharing 4.5. The annual drug cost at which medication therapy management is offered is 5330.0 USD on every plan; the maintenance drug count falls from 8 on the three lowest plans to 7 and then to 6.
